content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks nigeria

Stripe and similar services like PayPal and Gumroad offer a convenient way to sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-works|digital]] products, but they come with restrictions and fees. Stripe operates in 46 countries, leaving out many regions, including Nigeria and Ghana. PayPal's account suspension policies can be lengthy and costly, while Gumroad's fees can add up quickly. On the other hand, a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-6|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH provides a permanent structural alternative at the base layer, giving creators full ownership and control over their digital storefronts and payment processing.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad's payout delays, Payhip's withdrawal restrictions, and Lemon Squeezy's geographic unavailability all stem from the same root cause: these platforms operate within the traditional financial system. They process [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-what-actually-how-2|COREMERCH guide to payments]] through Stripe or PayPal on the backend, which means they inherit every restriction those processors impose. When Stripe does not support your country, Gumroad cannot pay you out — regardless of what the platform's feature list implies. Paddle operates as a merchant of record, which creates additional compliance requirements that make it functionally unavailable in most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not platform-level problems. They are financial system problems that only infrastructure built outside that system can solve.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.

A sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH provides a permanent structural alternative at the base layer, giving creators full ownership and control over their digital storefronts and payment processing.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're looking for a turnkey solution that can be deployed in 48 hours, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is an excellent option. This includes Stack 02, Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff. This is a great choice for creators who want a hassle-free setup and don't mind paying a premium for the convenience.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
A sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, with no additional costs or hidden fees.
